mage.name: Mage
mage.about: Wands and staffs: cheaper spells, frozen and transfigured foes, mana into health.

bard.name: Bard
bard.about: Mobility: speed, lighter stamina, higher jumps, songs that rest and lull.

knight.name: Knight
knight.about: Armour and melee: damage taken down, wards, stronger swings.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.about: Raw melee: fury, cleaving extra dice, life drawn from blows.

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.about: Dark spells: hexes, drained souls, poison, health traded for mana.

druid.name: Druid
druid.about: Nature: regrowth, thorns, entangling roots, foes turned into beasts.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.about: Stealth: hidden longer, sneak attacks anywhere, poison, fuller purses.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.about: Bows and crossbows: steadier aim, arrows spared, volleys of extra dice.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.about: Healing and protection: blessings, sanctuaries, divine light.
